_doc: v11 = v10.1 baseline + HarnessVLA/HarnessPAI strategy (scene re-grounding S2 + analytic transport S1). REQUIRES sim-side gt_injector.py to inject obs['r9_gt']; otherwise use_gt_poses silently falls back to RGB-D (v10.1 behavior). Deploy: copy this over profile_task7.json on the sim host AND wrap the env with gt_injector.EnvGTInjector, then restart b1k-sim-r9.
_provenance: v11 (per HarnessVLA与HarnessPAI策略借鉴.md): takes v10.1 (frozen baseline: r9_harness.py @ commit 15091b48) and ADDS two gated capabilities. (1) S2 scene re-grounding: when the sim-side gt_injector.py injects obs['r9_gt'] (robot-local toy/box poses from env.task.object_scope), the harness binds its aim target to the TRUE toy pose instead of the noisy RGB-D blob -- cures the int301-f '+16cm too high' empty-close and the furniture-over-toy mis-rank. (2) S1 analytic transport: on a confirmed grasp, the harness carries the toy to the GT box-approach pose and releases (instead of handing back to the VLA, which drops it on the long transport leg). Both gates are OFF by default in r9_harness.py DEFAULT_CONFIG; this profile turns them ON. NOTE: the policy runs in a separate container from the env, so GT MUST be injected sim-side (gt_injector.py) -- it is not readable from the policy wrapper.
